records.text: John Money promoted gender ideology through an experiment in which a boy injured in a botched circumcision was raised as a girl
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep 1IY2oD-_xVA)

appearances.snippet: John Money he's one of the greatest villains in history and he is the father of gender ideology and he became that by abusing two twin boys one of whom had his genitalia basically destroyed in a botched circumcision Money believed that sexuality was fluid convinced these parents that he could raise that boy as a girl and it would be fine long story short that didn't work out That boy was every bit a boy.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. Arizona State University's Embryo Project history documents John Money's role after David Reimer's botched circumcision and the decision to raise Reimer as a girl.

sources.title: David Reimer and John Money Gender Reassignment Controversy
sources.relevance: University history documents the botched circumcision and Money-directed reassignment.

records.text: John Money publicly claimed his gender experiment succeeded, but the participant later disclosed that it had failed and that Money had abused the twins
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep 1IY2oD-_xVA)

appearances.snippet: Money was a hero because he told the world that his experiment succeeded. And it wasn't until a young man comes out and tells his story that people realize not only did it not succeed, but he abused those boys horribly.

verification.notes: Transcript context reviewed. The ASU history documents Money's claims of success, later disclosures of coercive sexualized sessions involving the twins, and Reimer's rejection of the imposed identity.

sources.title: David Reimer and John Money Gender Reassignment Controversy
sources.relevance: University history documents Money's success claims, coercive abuse, and Reimer's later rejection.
